summary: Phase 2 testing for Nail's Passion PWA — new features (loyalty program, image management, hidden 5-tap admin access, theme toggle, prestation images, SumUp URL update). 27/27 backend pytest cases PASS (8 new Phase-2 tests added on top of the existing 19). Frontend Playwright sweep validated all new screens (/fidelite, /admin/images, /admin/loyalty, theme toggle on /profil) and regression on existing flows. Booking confirm correctly auto-increments db.loyalty (verified end-to-end: backend test created TEST_LoyClient with 1 visit, frontend /fidelite then showed '1/10' for the same phone, and /admin/loyalty listed TEST_LoyClient). Light theme renders cleanly (bg=rgb(255,245,249), text=rgb(26,10,20)) — fully readable. Hidden admin 5-tap on logo (data-testid=home-logo-tap) navigates to /admin within the 1.2s window.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exclude TEST_ phones; consider a query filter or admin-side filter for production cleanliness. Not blocking.
Still returns admin_pin via GET /api/settings (only /settings/public hides it). Flagged in iteration_1 as well — recommend gating /api/settings behind require_admin or always strip pin.

issues: Thumbnails render at 54x54px on Chromium (Tailwind w-14/h-14 ≈ 56px). Spec asked for 56x56 — visual diff negligible (2px), no action needed.
Native browser date/time picker still in use; not addressed this phase — still flagged for design parity.

action_items: (Optional) Gate GET /api/settings behind require_admin so the admin_pin is never exposed via any public route.
(Optional, carried over) Replace native date/time inputs in BookingScreen.jsx with shadcn Calendar + time picker.
(Optional) On /admin/loyalty, add a search/filter input so admins can find a client by phone or name when the list grows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 468 lines but remains cohesive (single domain). Still acceptable. If Phase 3 adds more endpoints, consider splitting into routers/ submodules (settings.py, loyalty.py, bookings.py).

Loyalty increment logic in PUT /api/bookings/{id}/status correctly handles idempotency (prev_status check) — verified by test_booking_confirm_increments_loyalty (re-confirming the same booking does NOT double-increment).
Phone normalization only strips spaces; consider also stripping +, -, (, ), and country-code differences to avoid duplicate loyalty records for the same client.
Light-theme contrast: body color rgb(26,10,20) on bg rgb(255,245,249) → contrast ratio ≈ 15:1, WCAG AAA compliant. Good.
Default Settings still has hard-coded admin_pin='1234'. Same flag as iteration_1 — for production, source from env or hashed value.
Loyalty endpoint /api/loyalty/{phone} returns visits=0 for unknown phones (no 404). That's fine UX-wise but document it so consumers know.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestPublicSettingsPhase2, TestPrestationImage, TestLoyalty classes — 8 new tests)
seed_data_creation: Reused iteration_1 seed (6 prestations + 9 gallery items). Phase-2 tests created TEST_ prefixed prestation/booking/loyalty rows and cleaned up bookings/prestations. db.loyalty entry for phone 0612TESTLOY (client_name TEST_LoyClient, 1 visit) remains — kept intentionally to validate the /fidelite frontend flow; can be cleaned by `db.loyalty.deleteMany({phone:/TEST/})` if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` — 27 tests cover original 19 + 8 new Phase-2. Admin PIN 1234. The 5-tap logo navigation MUST be tested at viewport 414x896 by clicking [data-testid='home-logo-tap'] 5x within 1.2s; do NOT use page.goto('/admin') as a substitute. Theme is read from document.documentElement.dataset.theme (set by AppContext after GET /api/settings/public). For admin-side theme persistence the toggle calls PUT /api/settings — for non-admin it falls back to localStorage. Loyalty record for phone 0612TESTLOY pre-exists from prior backend test runs.
rca of the issue: No bugs surfaced this iteration. All Phase 2 features (loyalty, image management, hidden admin, theme toggle, prestation images, SumUp URL) behave as specified end-to-end. No regressions in previously-passing flows (admin login, prestations CRUD, gallery, promotions, bookings).
